C0595.title: Apple Engineer Aude Leaks Multiple Unreleased Products and Sensitive Information
C0595.summary: An Apple iOS software engineer, Aude, exploited work access over five years to leak details of at least six unreleased products, including iPhone and Vision Pro. He sent over 10,000 anonymous tip messages to a Wall Street Journal reporter, disclosing product development policies, regulatory compliance strategies, and employee headcount. Apple terminated and sued him.
